Usage: pg0 start [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --name <NAME>          Instance name (allows running multiple instances) [default: default]
  -v, --verbose              Enable verbose logging
  -p, --port <PORT>          Port to listen on (auto-allocates if not specified and default port is in use)
  -V, --version <VERSION>    PostgreSQL version (must match bundled version) [default: 18.1.0]
  -d, --data-dir <DATA_DIR>  Data directory (defaults to ~/.pg0/instances/<name>/data)
  -u, --username <USERNAME>  Username for the database [default: postgres]
  -P, --password <PASSWORD>  Password for the database [default: postgres]
  -n, --database <DATABASE>  Database name to create [default: postgres]
  -c, --config <KEY=VALUE>   PostgreSQL configuration options (can be used multiple times) Example: -c shared_buffers=512MB -c work_mem=128MB
